OP1_ASH_01.text: Princess Melonsi Ananna of Seonha. Srov-trained. Do you know what that means, kid?
OP1_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_01.text: She can kindle a sword and she's rich?
OP1_DST_01.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_02.text: It means she's been told she's special by two separate institutions. Royalty, and the Srov. She's never carried her own bag. She's never been told 'no' by anyone who survived the conversation.
OP1_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

OP1_ASH_03.text: I've met the type. I was trained by the type. (a spark from the panel; he doesn't flinch) Three weeks missing on a Unity world, and the Srov send us? Two people they threw out?
OP1_ASH_03.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_03.text: They didn't throw me out. I left.
OP1_DST_03.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_04.text: You stowed away in a fuel locker and threw up on my boots. (beat) This is a leash, kid. They want us back in robes. Rescue the princess, come home, all is forgiven. I don't want to be forgiven.
OP1_ASH_04.speaker: Ashe

OP1_ASH_05.text: Because the pay's good, and because the princess is still a person in trouble. I'm not a monster. I'm a monster who reads contracts.
OP1_ASH_05.speaker: Ashe

OP1_ASH_06.text: ...Then you're a bigger moron than I raised. (beat) Than I put up with.
OP1_ASH_06.dir: he finally looks at Dust; a long, unreadable look
OP1_ASH_06.speaker: Ashe

OP1_DST_05.text: You ever going to fix that chip?
OP1_DST_05.speaker: Dust

OP1_DST_06.text: Still say a little soot on the flame gives it personality.
OP1_DST_06.speaker: Dust

OP1_ASH_10.text: And I still say you don't light that thing where people can see it. Not on a Unity world. Not ever.
OP1_ASH_10.speaker: Ashe

OP2_SHP_01.text: Attention passengers! The Galactic Companion is experiencing... hostile weapons fire. Please remain seated and enjoy the complimentary— (static)
OP2_SHP_01.speaker: Ship Computer

OP2_UNT_01.text: Unidentified Vors assault craft, you are inside Lumenhaven defense space. Cut your engines and prepare to be destroyed.
OP2_UNT_01.speaker: Unity Orbital Control

OP2_DST_01.text: 'Prepare to be destroyed' isn't really an option, it's more of a—
OP2_DST_01.speaker: Dust

OP3_DNA_01.text: The aft shield emitter, my aft shield emitter, the one I rebuilt from a toaster, a beautiful, loyal toaster, it's gone! And the port coupling's singing like a dying bird, and the inertial dampers are weeping, Ashe, I can hear them weeping, we are so dead, we are dead in a way that has paperwork—
OP3_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

OP3_KSB_01.dir: ducking through the hatch, cannon under one arm
OP3_KSB_01.subtitle: Station. Big one. Left side. We take it.
OP3_KSB_01.speaker: K'saabu

OP3_DNA_02.text: We are not landing on a Unity starbase and commandeering it! It has ten thousand people on it! We have four people and a frog!
OP3_DNA_02.speaker: Deena

OP3_KSB_02.subtitle: I am not a frog. I am a K'saabu.
OP3_KSB_02.speaker: K'saabu

OP3_DNA_03.text: You are a frog and I love you and no.
OP3_DNA_03.speaker: Deena

OP3_DNA_04.text: The planetary EMP shield, Ashe! It'll kill every circuit on this ship! We'll drop like a brick!
OP3_DNA_04.speaker: Deena

OP3_ASH_02.text: Not a brick. A glider. Kid?
OP3_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

OP3_DST_01.text: Galactic Companion-class. Passenger safety regs: total power loss means a hull designed to glide. Wings, spoilers, no power needed. It's in the brochure.
OP3_DST_01.speaker: Dust

OP3_ASH_03.text: Below the EMP line their batteries can't track us, because their targeting's shielded out too. We glide into the slums under the cloud deck. Nobody looks for a dead ship.
OP3_ASH_03.speaker: Ashe

OP3_DNA_05.text: If we gently glide in, they'll shoot us out of the sky before we hit the clouds!
OP3_DNA_05.speaker: Deena

OP3_ASH_04.text: Then we don't glide in gently. We go in fast and hard. (the smallest smile) Just the way you like it.
OP3_ASH_04.speaker: Ashe

OP3_DNA_06.text: You have no idea what I like, and now you'll never know, because we're all going to die because of your stupid plan!
OP3_DNA_06.speaker: Deena

OP3_DNA_07.text: And for a man who's supposedly fifty, you have the impulse control of a teenager.
OP3_DNA_07.speaker: Deena

OP3_ASH_06.text: When we hit atmosphere: spoilers up halfway. Wings out, not all the way, or the air rips them off. Two-thirds. Maybe three-fifths. Feel it.
OP3_ASH_06.speaker: Ashe

OP3_DNA_09.text: 'Feel it'? This plan is so bad, it's like Dust came up with it!
OP3_DNA_09.speaker: Deena

OP3_DST_04.text: It's a good plan. I'd have come up with it eventually.
OP3_DST_04.speaker: Dust

OP4_SHP_01.text: Attention passengers! A boarding pod has attached to the forward embarkation bay! The Galactic Companion welcomes all guests, but please—  (The EMP hits. The voice dies mid-word. Every screen goes black. The engines die. Silence, except the wind starting to howl against the hull.)
OP4_SHP_01.speaker: Ship Computer

OP4_ASH_01.text: We're gliding. Kid, you're with me, lounge. Deena, K'saabu, hold the cargo deck. Clear them out before they reach the cockpit. I need to be back in this chair before we hit the cloud deck, or we don't land, we arrive.
OP4_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

F1_ASH_01.text: Big one first. Always the big one first.
F1_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

F1_DST_01.text: And that's why you read the brochure.
F1_DST_01.speaker: Dust

F1_ASH_02.text: Unity issue armor. (beat, frowning at a body) ...cheap Unity issue armor.
F1_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

F2_DNA_01.text: Okay. Okay okay okay. Sweetheart, be good to me.
F2_DNA_01.dir: fight start, hands shaking on her pistol
F2_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

F2_DNA_02.text: ...I love you so much, you horrible frog.
F2_DNA_02.dir: bark, after K'saabu's first cannon blast
F2_DNA_02.speaker: Deena

T2_ASH_01.text: Forward embarkation bay. That's where they're coming in. We close that pod off, or we never stop fighting.
T2_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

T2_DNA_01.text: The bay doors are dead. Everything's dead. The EMP—
T2_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

T2_ASH_02.text: Then we do it the old way.
T2_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

F3_ASH_01.text: Look at that hardware. Even if I was a day-one private, I'd say these damned greaseballs are mercs dressed up in Unity armour.
F3_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

F3_ASH_02.text: Don't really matter what they were. Scum paid to kill is all I know.
F3_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe

F3_DNA_00.text: Why would pirates board us while we're being shot at by Planetary Defence?
F3_DNA_00.speaker: Deena

F3_DST_02.text: Don't really matter. They won't live long enough to tell anyone about us.
F3_DST_02.speaker: Dust

F3_DNA_02.text: No eating people when anyone else is around! Even pirates!
F3_DNA_02.speaker: Deena

F3_SGT_01.text: The traitors are yonder! Open fire!
F3_SGT_01.speaker: Sergeant

F3_KSB_01.dir: if the Sergeant is shoved behind the door
F3_KSB_01.subtitle: Door. Is like small station.
F3_KSB_01.speaker: K'saabu

F3_DNA_01.text: Oh! Oh, the door's on the passenger-safety battery! Bless passenger safety! Somebody hit that panel!
F3_DNA_01.dir: if she finds the door Insight
F3_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

OP5_DST_01.text: These aren't Unity. Ashe, they had our flight plan. The one we only gave the Srov.
OP5_DST_01.speaker: Dust

OP5_ASH_01.text: Then someone in the Srov talks to people with candle tattoos. Later. Cockpit.
OP5_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

OP5_DNA_01.text: I've never... I fix things. I don't...
OP5_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

OP5_DST_02.text: Hey. You saved my life twice back there. I counted. (beat) You're still the person who fixes things. You just fixed us.
OP5_DST_02.speaker: Dust

OP5_KSB_01.subtitle: Good. Both alive. Stupid, but alive.
OP5_KSB_01.speaker: K'saabu

OP6_DNA_01.text: We're alive. We're alive. Nobody talk to me. I need to kiss the ground. Where is the ground.
OP6_DNA_01.dir: climbing out of the hatch, hair everywhere
OP6_DNA_01.speaker: Deena

OP6_ASH_01.dir: stepping out, brushing glass off his coat, utterly calm
OP6_ASH_01.speaker: Ashe

OP6_ASH_02.text: We're in a wall on the planet.
OP6_ASH_02.speaker: Ashe
